summary: Fix the Controller appliance updater so a binary-only appliance installs its first nex-controller Debian package instead of letting apt --only-upgrade succeed without installing it. The local fix is not rebuilt or published.

guide.reason: The existing 0.2.9 binary-only appliance has a direct manual recovery, and future helper behavior installs its first package.

api.reason: GET and POST /api/v1/updates retain their endpoints, schemas, authorization, asynchronous result flow and errors. The existing apply operation now completes the first package install for a binary-only appliance.

roadmap.reason: Fixes the existing updater; no milestone or public release status changes.

state.reason: No durable record is added or moved. Existing transient pending-update and progress files retain their current helper behavior.

verification.method: The simulated binary-only helper regression failed before the fix and passes after it. python3 -m unittest tests/test_distribution_packaging.py -v passed 24 tests. No appliance package rebuild, repository publication, browser workflow, or live target operation was run or claimed.
